data_origin: Original synthetic offline task inputs; not field-collected evidence

design.assignment: Independent fair within-block L/R flip; one mulch plot and one control
design.endpoint: Mean dry seed mass of six prespecified central plants, g/plant
design.estimand: Equal-weight average plot-level treatment effect in these four blocks at this site-season; causal interpretation assumes consistency and no spillover

primary.interval_limit: t reference interval requires extra modeling of block differences; no exact finite-design 95% coverage claim
primary.exact_95_constant_effect_inversion: All real numbers: with only 16 assignments a nonrandomized two-sided absolute-mean sign-flip p is at least 2/16, so no constant additive effect is rejected at alpha=.05

plant_number_pseudopairs.invalid_reason: Six subsamples share one plot-level assignment; plant-number matching across plots is not a randomized pairing

all_rows_unblocked.invalid_reason: Ignores plot dependence and block matching; not design-valid despite larger SE here

draft_p_003.reason: No bootstrap algorithm, seed, resampling unit, null construction or code supplied; cannot verify the exact claimed p

exploratory_excluding_B4.status: Sensitivity only; retains B4 in primary analysis; dropping changes finite target

scope_limits: One site-season only; blocks are not a national random sample
Crop species, calibration and blinding not supplied; cannot infer measurement traceability
No area yield, economic, pest, or environmental endpoint
B4 supplementary irrigation affected both plots; not an independent irrigation comparison

execution.seed_reason: No Monte Carlo: complete enumeration and deterministic arithmetic
